about.description: I'm a Mathematics major with a Computer Science minor, based in Toronto. I'm especially drawn to their overlap, such as cryptography, graph theory, and information theory. I also enjoy turning that theory into things people can actually use. Outside of coursework, I build web apps, contribute to open source, and explore AI tools. I am also interested in exploring research opportunities and am open to collaborations with researchers.

contact.location: Toronto (EST) · I usually reply within a day
